Use the `revision` token from the previous [`RefundHistoryResponse`](refundhistoryresponse.md). You can store the `revision` token from the final results page and use it for a future call. For more information, see [`RefundHistoryResponse`](refundhistoryresponse.md). The `revision` token is required in all requests except the initial request.
